title: Parcel handoff
idea: Parcel handoff: Recipient and parcel details end with an explicit handoff review
audience: People who need to handoff within a mobile surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic transaction layout through its handoff priority and explicit commitment contract: Do not mark delivered until confirmed by the authorized flow
navigation: Parcel handoff keeps the current handoff context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Recipient and parcel details end with an explicit handoff review
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to handoff; a physical transfer needs confirmation
composition.priority: Do not mark delivered until confirmed by the authorized flow

imagery.role: Support the actual handoff context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep identifiers readable and allow manual correction
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the parcel handoff structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no handoff content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Do not mark delivered until confirmed by the authorized flow
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized handoff content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Do not mark delivered until confirmed by the authorized flow
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active handoff context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
